headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Dealing with Utility Shutoffs for Repairs
articleBody: When you're facing a plumbing repair that requires a utility shutoff, it's easy to make a few common mistakes that can cause bigger headaches. First, don't assume you can handle the shutoff and restoration yourself, especially with gas lines; always leave that to licensed professionals. Second, neglecting to coordinate with the utility company directly can lead to unexpected delays or even fines. They need to know what's happening. Third, trying to rush the restoration process is a big no-no – safety first! Also, failing to properly test the system after restoration could lead to leaks or other issues. For instance, if you're dealing with a gas line repair for your water heater, you really want an expert handling both the shutoff and the restart to ensure no dangerous gas leaks. Finally, don't skip getting a professional inspection of the affected lines once service is restored.
